coordinate_system.orientation_notes: Z follows the longitudinal bore and turning axis. X is horizontal and Y is vertical in the end view. Section A-A lies in the YZ plane with its cut normal along X. No datum-based origin is established.

features.name: Knurl serration detail
features.description: Knurl tooth profile specified at 28-32 places equally spaced at both ends, defined by a 50° included angle, 0.19–0.32 mm tooth depth, and 0.76 mm max root/flat width.

features.name: Central through bore
features.description: Full-length longitudinal through bore with corner break chamfers at each end.

features.name: Central outer cylinder body
features.description: Outer cylindrical body between the two end flanges.

features.name: Flanged ends
features.description: Cylindrical raised flanges at both ends of the component with knurled end faces.

features.name: Flange transition fillet
features.description: Radius transitioning from the backside face of each flange to the central outer diameter.

features.name: Overall part envelope
features.description: Overall tubular component body measured across end faces under knurls.

relationships.detail: The longitudinal bore and central outer cylinder share the component centerline in Section A-A.
Both end flanges are centered on the longitudinal through-bore axis.
The end-view annular serration pattern is centered on the through bore.
Section B-B specifies equally spaced serrations on both flanged end faces.
The serration profile is formed in the end faces of the flanges.
Each transition fillet joins the backside surface of an end flange.
The flange transition fillets blend into the central outer-cylinder surface.

datum_scheme.datum_hierarchy_notes: No datum definitions or datum-referenced GD&T controls are supplied. A-A and B-B identify section cuts; the revision and conformance markers do not establish datums.

feature_graph.part_notes: Material: SAE J403 GRADE 1008-1020. Material standard: SAE J403. Scale: 1:1. General tolerance: ASME Y14.5M-1994. Projection: third angle. Heat treatment: none specified. Coating: PHOSPHATE COAT PER PS-119.0. General notes: DEBURR: BREAK ALL SHARP EDGES 0.5 MAX.. FINISH: PHOSPHATE COAT PER PS-119.0. INSPECTION: [HEXAGON SYMBOL] = MUST CONFORM TO LAST NUMBER = 2 TOTAL NUMBER = 2. METRIC DIMENSIONS & TOLERANCES GOVERN THE DESIGN. ENGLISH DIMENSIONS IF INCLUDED ARE FOR INFORMATION PURPOSES ONLY.. Testing: CRUSH TEST per PS-122.10 (121kN, 60.5kN, 0.38mm).

assumptions.text: The explicit SECTION B-B reference establishes that front_view:F1 and section_bb:F1 describe the same serration feature. Section B-B is canonical because it directly defines the tooth profile; the front-view observation supplies the annular boundaries.

The serrations at both ends remain one repeated-feature family because no section models the ends individually. Likewise, the flange pair and transition-fillet pair retain their existing repeated-feature observations rather than being split into unsupported individual nodes.

The knurl is interpreted as an end-face serration pattern, not a circumferential knurled band. Consequently, the extraction request for a separate axial band length is not treated as a missing machining dimension.
